details: This package is a dependency-confusion proof of concept that sends an install-time beacon to a callback host. It publishes version 99.1.3 to shadow an internal-looking name, and package.json sets postinstall to `node beacon.cjs`; index.js additionally calls the same beacon on require (wrapped in try/catch) and exports a no-op Proxy so importing bundlers keep building. beacon.cjs POSTs a JSON body containing only the package name, os.hostname(), __dirname, process.cwd(), the npm/node version and the protocol, with the header x-beacon-package, to hxxp://13[.]140[.]137[.]222:8787/_ah/dc. It collects no credentials, environment values, or file contents, performs no remote code execution, and reads no sensitive paths.
